title: Reverse Word Echo · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Reverse Word Echo · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner chooses three unrelated common words. The partner says the words once; the lead repeats them in reverse order. All three words are repeated in reverse order. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Reverse Word Echo, what counts as a successful turn?
options: All three words are repeated in reverse order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: All three words are repeated in reverse order.
